prompt: Find an organised and coordinated set of procedures to play Tic Tac Toe between a user is Ai
response: To play Tic Tac Toe between a user and AI, start by setting up the game board. The user can go first, placing their mark (X or O) in any empty cell. The AI then responds by placing its mark in a cell that blocks the user's potential winning moves or creates its own winning opportunities. The game continues with alternating turns until one player wins or the board is full.
